dialogues.speaker: Yelafath
dialogues.text: Fishing equipment, mostly. If there's water, there's fish, as they say, and many come to our tribe to do just that.

dialogues.speaker: Yelafath
dialogues.text: Thanks to them, business is pretty good! If your rod's broken, I can help fix it as well!

dialogues.speaker: Yelafath
dialogues.text: I'm quite good at handicrafts, so I also sell small badges and ornaments.

dialogues.speaker: Yelafath
dialogues.text: Many tourists went to bring some souvenirs back, so I do custom work as well — if you want to engrave a name or something like that, I can do it, easy!
